candidates.title: Prepare a stock-count difference report

demandEvidence.chore: Staff record shelf counts and review differences before stock levels change.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: a small shop might pay for less manual stock reconciliation; this discussion proves no AI-service buyer or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can compare supplied test counts with a sample list; live Shopify access and accuracy remain unverified.

autonomy.reason: A proposed comparison can flag differences repeatedly, while a person verifies counts and approves any stock change.

evidence.reason: The fresh post gives a concrete count-and-review chore, but no recurrence, constraints or implementation evidence.

candidates.reason: The discussion describes staff recording shelf counts and reviewing differences before stock levels change. A test reconciliation is scorable, but its small-shop buyer overlaps recent post 98b4f6281cc3de4ecdfa95f6; mean 23/5 = 4.6.
